field_edits.updated_text: There is diffuse osseous demineralization. Mild dextroconvex thoracolumbar curvature is present. Vertebral body heights are maintained without acute compression fracture.
There is multilevel degenerative disc space narrowing and endplate osteophyte formation, greatest at L4-L5.

impression:
